narrationTexts: Confirms the theory: `orderTotal` is the only broken function, 3 failing cases where both discount and tax are non-zero.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 total, 625 passing.**

Only `orderTotal` in [pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) was broken. It taxed the pre-discount `cents` instead of the discounted amount, so it silently overcharged tax whenever both a discount and a tax rate applied.

Fixed it to tax the discounted total, matching the spec in `cases.js`.

Next: nothing, all 9 suites pass.
